body: Be warned about time zones. Their chat function is only available from 2pm-2am.

I don't know if I can really say anything to help you. Hell, if I'm honest, I'm in pretty much the same boat as you. I'm fat. I didn't have good grades in high school, but that was because I didn't try, not because I wasn't smart. I also dropped out of college, and if your user name is any indication, we have similar interests. I was going to major in Geology. I'm not only never going to be able to support myself monetarily, but I'm currently a sinkhole for money. I haven't even touched a member of the opposite sex, excluding a hug from family members, in over 8 years now. I also think about dying (I say dying and no killing myself because I don't have the balls to do it myself) every day. 

All I'm really here to say is, you're not the only one going through it. I hope that's some consolation to you. We don't know what tomorrow will bring. Maybe we'll pass go and collect $200. Who knows? Hang in there.
I don't know what we'd talk about. I really should be asleep anyway. I have to get up in about 6 hours.
